text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
choice_data_list: Your nose is bleeding! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sorry… It doesn't look like it's going to stop anytime soon…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I was getting myself fired up for training, but my cheer ended up going, "Ei, ei, blwargh!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I have no idea why my nose is bleeding, though. I didn't even bump into anything today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The exhaustion from running so many consecutive races may be catching up with her. Looks like I need to rethink her schedule.
